review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 18 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown plus fence/heading inventory. This source's PDF text layer hyphenates aggressively (re markable, cou ples, specif ically), which explains most diff hits together with Figure 1-6 internal texts and appendix mosaic labels. Real defects were all heading promotions: the page-break-split sentence 'Image-Edit [50]) achieves an improvement of +6.1%.' below Table 1, three 'W/ Rensoning' column labels, and eleven '[Reflection]'/[Reflection-roundN] panel labels; all demoted to plain text matching their printed style. The source's own 'Rensoning' misspelling is preserved as printed. Table 1 values, references and acknowledgments spot-checked.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.7 prints 'Image-Edit [50]) achieves an improvement of +6.1%.' as body text below Table 1 - the continuation of the Sec. 4.2.2 sentence broken by the page break ('...while ReasonEdit-Q (derived from Qwen-' ends physical p.6). The OCR markdown promoted the continuation into a '##' heading; the patch demotes it to plain body text.

Rendered physical pp.14-16 print 'W/ Rensoning' only as a column label of the appendix result mosaics (Figures 7-9; the spelling 'Rensoning' is the source's own typo and is kept). The sibling label 'W/O Rensoning' is not transcribed as a heading; the patch demotes the three promoted copies to plain text like the neighboring '[Instruction]' lines.

Rendered physical pp.14-18 show '[Reflection]' only as red panel labels inside the appendix result mosaics (Figures 7-10), parallel to '[Thinking]' labels that stay inside the embedded figure crops. The OCR markdown promoted six copies to '##' headings; the patch demotes them to plain text.

Same defect class as the '[Reflection]' headings: the rendered appendix mosaics print '[Reflection-round1]' as panel labels, and the document body already keeps inline occurrences such as '[Reflection-round1] <#Think> ...' as plain text. The patch demotes the two promoted headings.
Same defect class as the '[Reflection]' headings: panel labels of the appendix mosaics on physical pp.15-16, printed in red inside the figure grid; demoted to plain text.
